'''Hummel Carbine''' was the manufacturer of the [[V-71 Ridge Piranha]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engine. One of those engines was sold by [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] at his [[Watto's junkshop|shop]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This company was mentioned in a video commercial for Watto's shop found on the [[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Episode I Insider's Guide'']] CD-ROM.
